messages:
maria: Heads-up: final coordination for Friday's announcement. We need engineering to lock the canonical changelog URL, confirm rollout windows, and give a short migration callout for the post. Publish target: Fri 09:00 PT. Any last-minute constraints?
kevin: Changelog final draft will land in the docs repo later today. Which pages should marketing link to  release notes only or also the migration checklist and rollout plan?
ash: Please link all three: release notes, migration checklist, and a short 'what's changed' anchor. I'll add anchors and a redirect page so marketing can use a single short URL.
lila: For webinar CTA: we need a 25-30s teaser blurb to put in the announcement and a registration link. Also include timezone conversions (PT/CEST/KST).
maria: Good call. Kevin, can you push the final links by 5pm PT?
kevin: Yes. Draft changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9b3f2a (will push final later). Planning canary: start 09:00 PT, 20m canary, then 40m gradual ramp to 50%, hold 1h, full at +2:00 if green.
ash: Ops checklist to monitor: 5xx rate, model token error spikes, and median p95 latency. Autoswitch rule: if 5xx > 0.2% for 5m -> roll back.
lila: Inbound routing: marketing form should tag region so sales can route. Can we add X-Region header and also capture utm_source?
announce-bot: infra-bot: staging form updated. Example payload: ```http
POST /api/register
Headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Region": "EU", "X-Source": "announce-email"}
Body: {"email":"jane@example.com","name":"Jane"}
```
maria: Perfect. Sales ask: map NA->sdr-na, EMEA->sdr-emea, APAC->sdr-apac. Kevin, who's the point for the routing rule?
kevin: @ash will own the mapping in staging; ash: can you confirm?
ash: Confirmed. I will add the mapping and a note in the ops-runbook. If inbound >50/day for any region, notify growth@ for overflow handling.
lila: Messaging: we want two subject lines to A/B test for 12h after send. Proposals: A) "New rollout toolkit: safer LLM updates at lower cost" B) "Ship production LLMs with confidence  release + webinar" Thoughts?
maria: Sounds good. Also need a 1-sentence tweet-sized summary and a 3-line blog header. Who wants to draft?
kevin: Tweet-size: "Reduce inference cost and risk: smarter batching, KV caching, and canary rollouts. Read the release + join our webinar: https://events.redwood.ai/sep2024"
ash: Blog header: "Today we release new rollout tooling and docs to make LLM inference in production safer and cheaper. Join our live demo: https://events.redwood.ai/sep2024 (Fri 09:00 PT)."
announce-bot: infra-bot: scheduled canary window: 2024-09-20T09:00:00-07:00 -> canary_end 09:20, ramp 09:20-10:00, hold until 11:00, full 11:00. PD contacts: eng-oncall -> kevin, eng-sre -> maya. Reminder ping at 08:45 PT.
maria: One more ask: marketing wants a single short migration note copy (2 bullets) to include in the post and the docs callout. Can someone paste it here?
ash: Migration snippet: "1) Pin existing model version before upgrade. 2) Test with 10% traffic using the new canary policy; if latency or error thresholds breach, the system auto-rolls back."
lila: I'll embed that in the release landing and add webinar CTA anchor: /events/#sep2024-webinar. Also adding partner note: "For high-volume inbound routing or SSO needs, contact enterprise@redwood.ai."
kevin: Final changelog link (live): https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-09-20/changelog.html 
maria: Thanks all. I'll build the announcement post with those links and drop assets (tweet copy, subject lines, header image) by 6pm PT. Well post Friday 09:00 PT. :rocket: 
ash: thumbs_up
lila: :sparkles:
announce-bot: infra-bot: reminder set for 2024-09-20T08:45:00-07:00 to start canary monitoring and to post the announce to #announce.
